title: God Is Opening Doors Around the World
description: In this exciting sermon from Pastor Chris Zehner, discover the incredible global outreach of The River Church of Kansas City as they prepare to travel to South Africa and the Middle East to preach the Gospel, heal the sick, and lay hands on those in need. Hear Pastor Chris share the vision of this mission and how God is opening doors for this church to spread the love of Christ to the nations. Join Pastor Chris as he shares the updates and prayers for this mission and encourages the church to pray with him for a successful and God-honoring trip.
